results.title: Airalo - Senior Analytics Engineer, Finance
results.text:
Airalo - Senior Analytics Engineer, Finance

## Senior Analytics Engineer, Finance

### Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

### Your Next Destination

- Location: Remote, anywhere in Spain or the UK.
- Contract:

- Spain: Full-time, permanent contrato indefinido via Deel (our employer of record in Spain)
- UK: Full-time, permanent
- Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74
- Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

Curious what it's actually like to work at Airalo? We've put together a guide for each of the hubs we hire from most, covering our benefits, remote culture, employment setup, and what our team values most:

- Life at Airalo · España: https://airalo-public.notion.site/life-at-airalo-espana
- Life at Airalo · United Kingdom: https://airalo-public.notion.site/life-at-airalo-united-kingdom

We’re looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help shape how data is modeled and governed at Airalo, transforming first- and third-party data into clean, trusted, well-documented datasets that power decisions across product, marketing, finance, and commercial teams, serving 30+ million users and growing. This role carries particular weight in our finance and revenue domain: you’ll steward the models finance relies on directly, including order-to-revenue flows and reconciliation against third-party systems such as our ERP, where precision and auditability matter as much as scalability.

Our analytics engineering function is still maturing, so you’ll have real ownership in establishing standards, defining our semantic layer, and shaping how data is structured as we scale globally, working closely with the rest of the data team to build a production-grade analytics platform on LightDash and beyond.

### What You'll Do:

- Design, implement, and maintain data models using dbt within our cloud data warehouse, ensuring performance, cost efficiency, and alignment with business logic
- Build and maintain finance and revenue data models, including order-to-revenue flows, recognition logic, and reconciliation against source-of-truth financial systems, that finance and commercial teams can rely on for reporting and forecasting
- Own the order-to-revenue pipeline: ensuring every order correctly and traceably resolves into recognized revenue, with clear handling of refunds, adjustments, currency conversion, and edge cases
- Collaborate with other analytics engineers and data engineers to build and scale ELT workflows that ensure data freshness and reliability for mission-critical reporting
- Partner with Finance and the ERP systems integrator to validate that data models and definitions carry over correctly from legacy systems into the new ERP/EPM platform
- Implement robust testing, documentation, and monitoring practices, acting as a steward of data quality and governance across the platform, with particularly high attention to detail in domains where small errors compound (e.g., revenue, finance)
- Collaborate cross-functionally to translate complex business questions into scalable, production-ready data artifacts
- Partner with the data analysts and domain leadership to drive the rollout and adoption of self-service analytics, ensuring business users can trust and independently explore the data models you build
- Contribute to the evolution of our modern data stack, bringing curiosity and pragmatic judgment to new tools and approaches

### Must Haves:

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in a quantitative field (statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science, or equivalent work experience)
- Hands-on experience building finance and/or revenue data models, ideally including order-to-revenue or billing-to-revenue pipelines, revenue recognition logic, or financial reconciliation (ERP, billing platforms or similar)
- 5+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or analytics roles with significant modeling responsibilities
- Strong SQL and data modeling skills, with demonstrated experience designing robust, scalable dimensional models
- Exceptional attention to detail, especially when working with numbers that feed financial reporting, reconciliation, or external disclosure
- Significant hands-on experience with dbt (Core or Cloud) for managing transformation logic, testing, and documentation
- Familiarity with cloud data platforms (BigQuery) and data orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, or similar)
- Experience working with modern BI platforms and semantic layers-LightDash experience is a strong plus
- Track record of partnering with analysts and business stakeholders to translate requirements into well-structured data products
- Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data concepts to diverse audiences
- Proactive self-starter who thrives on solving ambiguous problems and takes ownership from concept to production

### Nice to Have:

- Experience in marketplace, telecom, or travel/mobility businesses
- Background in B2C product companies with high-volume event data
- Experience building analytics engineering capabilities in low-maturity data environments
- Previous experience at a scale-up that went through hypergrowth
- Experience defining and governing company-wide KPIs and metric frameworks
- Experience working alongside or within a finance function (e.g., supporting FP&A, revenue accounting, or audit processes) on data accuracy and traceability

£74,800 - £112,200 a year

At Airalo, we believe in roaming-free recruitment. Just as we provide clear connectivity for travelers, we provide clear salary ranges for our candidates. 🌍

This role is remote and open to candidates across our supported locations in Europe. The range below reflects the full salary range for this role across the countries where it's available:

📍 UK: £74,800 – £112,200 📍 Spain: €77,600 – €116,400 📍 Germany: €76,000 - €114,000 Your Home Destination: 🛫 Local market rates and cost of living vary, so your specific range depends on where you’re based. Most people join in the first half of the band, which leaves you plenty of room to grow, and you’ll see exactly how that looks from day one. In exceptional cases, where a candidate’s skills and experience clearly exceed what the role requires, we’re happy to talk about going higher. We’ll walk through your range together on your first call with our Talent team, so we’re all aligned for takeoff! 🎒✨

### 🇪🇸 Why people join us in Spain

We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.

Our team is united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact.

For many of our teammates in Spain, it's the combination of stability, flexibility, and genuine work-life balance that makes Airalo feel like home.

### 🇬🇧 Why people join us in the UK

We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product first discovered us as customers.

Our team spans 60+ countries, but what people often notice quickly is how work actually feels here. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.

As Airalo continues to grow, people tend to stay for a mix of things: the chance to work on a product used globally, the autonomy to shape how they work, and the opportunity to keep taking on new challenges without getting stuck in one lane.

### Before You Hit Apply

By applying, you acknowledge and agree that, in case of successful application, Airalo may request to run background checks as a condition for entering into an agreement with you. Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. All data that you share or that we collect in connection with such checks will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy, available here: www.airalo.com/more-info/privacy-policy?srsltid=AfmBOooBT0rXAj1FaNelZ3VfN0wvhwzvAoxdtHnOKSVETpiSjiXVuycy 

We sincerely thank all applicants in advance for submitting their interest in this opportunity. Airalo is an equal-opportunity employer and values diversity, equity & inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations upon request for individuals with disabilities throughout our job interview process.

At Airalo, we use AI-assisted tools as part of our recruitment process. Your application will be reviewed using tools that help our recruiters analyze and organize CV information. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgment; all hiring decisions are made by humans. If you progress to an interview, we may use tools to generate AI-assisted notes - you can opt out of these. For more information on how we handle your data, please see our Privacy Policy: https://www.airalo.com/more-info/privacy-policy.

# Senior Analytics Engineer @ Paddle

- Location: UK
- Other locations: Portugal, Ireland
- Type: FullTime
- Workplace: Remote
- Team: Product & Engineering
- Department: Product & Engineering

**What do we do?**

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. 

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. 

**The Role:  **

We are seeking a Senior Analytics Engineer to drive significant business impact by shaping our data infrastructure, developing robust data models, and promoting best practices in analytics engineering (e.g., data quality, documentation, and scalable data architectures). You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders to identify and deliver high-value data solutions and provide informal mentorship to junior team members, fostering their growth and enhancing team capabilities.

**What you'll do: **

- Create and maintain complex, scalable data models in Snowflake using dbt.

- Expose datasets effectively in BI tooling to enable robust self-service analytics.

- Perform simple data ingestion tasks using no-code tools and ensure streamlined data flows.

- Add comprehensive metadata to datasets, including documentation, data quality checks, and sensitive data masking.

- Activate data by pushing it from Snowflake into other operational tools.

- Proactively identify and raise data quality issues to the respective process owners for resolution.

- Lead training sessions and initiatives to drive adoption and effective use of BI tools across the organization.

- Mentor junior analytics engineers, fostering knowledge-sharing and professional growth.

**We'd love to hear from you if you:**

- Extensive experience in analytics engineering or related data roles, with demonstrated expertise in advanced SQL, dbt, and Snowflake.

- Proficient in using BI tools (e.g. Tableau, Looker, PowerBI, Snowsight) to deliver clear, actionable insights for business stakeholders.

- Skilled in performing data ingestion and activation using no-code tools (e.g. Fivetran, Stitch), ensuring efficient data integration into operational systems.

- Knowledgeable in managing metadata, documentation, data quality checks, and sensitive data masking effectively.

- Effective at collaborating closely with diverse stakeholders, understanding their data needs, and delivering impactful solutions.

- Experienced in conducting training sessions and providing informal mentorship to junior analytics team members, fostering a collaborative and knowledge-sharing environment.

**Everyone is welcome at Paddle**

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

**Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed.** We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

 **Why you’ll love working at Paddle**

We’re a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

- **Paddle Together** - *“None of us, is as smart as all of us”*

- **Paddle Simply** - *“Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”*

- **Paddle for others** - *“We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”*

 We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives.

 We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

 **Connecting at Paddle**

We’re a** ‘digital-first’ company**, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.

We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.

 Our Paddle hubs:

- **In Europe:** UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)

- **In North America: **Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)

- **In APAC**: Singapore

Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work.

 To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

**
** Immersive is the cyber proving ground for the AI enterprise. Through Immersive One, organizations can test whether people, AI-enabled workflows, cyber security teams, agents, and leaders can perform securely under realistic pressure, then turn that performance into evidence they can use to improve, benchmark, and report readiness.

Trusted by 30%+ of the Fortune 100 and ranked #1 in the Forrester Wave™ 2026, Immersive helps organizations prove AI can be adopted safely, teams can develop and defend at AI speed, leaders can lead through crisis, and AI agents can be validated before they are trusted in live workflows

Head of Global Cybersecurity Operations, HSBC

Immersive is hiring! Could you be our next Senior Analytics Engineer?

Come and join our established UK Engineering team as a Senior Analytics Engineer - We are looking for someone curious, eager to solve problems, and excited to build alongside a collaborative team.

We are not just seeking a skillset though - we are looking for someone who will also become an important and vital part of our team, so we seek a driven, curious and collaborative person to become our next colleague

- You have experience following software engineering best practices like version control and continuous integration

- You have strong proficiency using SQL in cloud data warehouses (we use Snowflake) and are comfortable with performance optimization, data partitioning, and window functions

- You are able to operate effectively and autonomously across multiple teams in situations of ambiguity, with only high-level direction

- Experience with BI tooling such as Power BI or Looker

**Immersive’s growth has been fuelled by our values that underpin everything we do, here's how they relate to this role:**

We exceed our customers and partners expectations by crafting products, services and experience that surprise, delight and ensuring they feel valued and supported every day.

Job Application for Senior Growth Engineer at Engine

# Senior Growth Engineer

Remote - US

### About Engine

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents. That work has earned Engine recognition as TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), a spot on Inc.'s Power Partners list (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026). We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar. Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

About the Role

Engine is building a Growth Engineering function to solve some of our most important go-to-market challenges through software, data, and automation. We’re looking for a Senior Growth Engineer who combines strong engineering fundamentals with an understanding of how GTM teams operate.

You’ll sit at the intersection of engineering and go-to-market building production-grade systems that help us identify the right accounts, prioritize opportunities, automate workflows, and make our teams more effective.

Your Mission

Help Engine scale customer acquisition by building the technical systems behind how we source, prioritize, and engage accounts. You’ll work directly with Sales and Growth to uncover opportunities, experiment quickly, and turn the best ideas into reliable, scalable systems.

What You'll Own

- GTM Tools & Automation: Build internal tools, services, and automations that make Sales and Growth teams faster and more effective.
- Account Sourcing & Signals: Identify and operationalize creative data signals that help Engine find and prioritize high-potential accounts across existing and new verticals.
- Data & Integrations: Build pipelines and integrations that connect external data, Salesforce, and other GTM systems.
- Production Engineering: Design, build, deploy, and maintain reliable applications with strong architectural, security, and scalability practices.
- GTM Partnership: Work directly with sales reps and Growth leaders to understand workflows, identify friction, and translate business needs into technical solutions.
- Experimentation: Prototype quickly, launch experiments, measure impact, and turn successful ideas into durable systems.
- Technical Quality: Help improve the architecture, reliability, and quality of tools and applications built across the Growth organization.

What You’ll Bring to Engine

- 5+ years of software engineering experience, including building and maintaining production applications.
- Strong system-design fundamentals and experience making architectural decisions.
- Strong proficiency in a modern tech stack.
- Experience building APIs, integrations, data pipelines, internal tools, or automation systems.
- Experience working with or alongside Sales, Growth, Marketing, Revenue Operations, or another GTM function.
- Familiarity with Salesforce and modern data, enrichment, or automation tools.
- Strong business judgment and the ability to connect technical work to customer acquisition, efficiency, and revenue.
- A builder mindset - you’re comfortable moving from an ambiguous problem to a working solution and iterating quickly.

Nice to Have

- Experience with account prioritization, prospecting, enrichment, intent signals, or sales automation.
- Experience with Snowflake or a modern cloud data stack.
- Experience using AI or LLM-based tools to build or accelerate internal workflows.
- Experience in a B2B, SMB, marketplace, travel, or high-growth technology environment.

Compensation Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

Base Pay Range

$135,150

$187,000

USD

The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:

- Compensation: Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions. This range is our good-faith estimate for the role. Where you land within it depends on your experience, skills, and location. If your expectations fall outside the range, please apply anyway. We’d love to talk.
- Benefits: Check out our full list at engine.com/culture 
- Environments for Success: Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more

# Lead Engineer, Member Growth @ Circle

- Location: Anywhere
- Other locations: Europe, Middle East, Africa (EMEA), Europe, Middle East, Africa (EMEA), North America, South America (AMER), North America, South America (AMER), Europe, Middle East, Africa (EMEA), North America, South America (AMER), North America, South America (AMER), EMEA, Europe, Middle East, Africa (EMEA), North America, South America (AMER), North America, South America (AMER), North America, South America (AMER), Europe, Middle East, Africa (EMEA), North America, South America (AMER), Europe, Middle East, Africa (EMEA), Europe, Middle East, Africa (EMEA), Europe, Middle East, Africa (EMEA), North America, South America (AMER), North America, South America (AMER), Europe, Middle East, Africa (EMEA), United States, North America, South America (AMER), North America, South America (AMER)
- Type: FullTime
- Workplace: Remote
- Team: R&D
- Department: R&D
- Compensation: $162K • Offers Equity

### About Us

Circle is building the world’s leading AI-powered, all-in-one platform for digital businesses. We make it possible for creators, coaches, educators, and businesses to bring together their audience with engaging discussions, live streams, events, chat, courses, and payments — all in one place, all under their own brand.

We’re proud to be a fully remote company of around 270 (and growing!) team members from 30+ countries around the world. We seek exceptional individuals around the world, set them up to do the best work of their lives, and in turn, create a meaningful impact in their own lives. We don't track hours, but we do manage for high expectations very closely. We collaborate across time zones, are highly async, and like to document a lot.

Every year, we bring the whole company together in beautiful places around the world for our company offsites. So far, we’ve hosted offsites in Turkey, Portugal, Mexico, Thailand, Colombia, Italy, Ireland, and more, with still more to come!

Check out ourCareers page for more about working at Circle.

### About the role

Circle’s Growth team owns three pillars: Billing (SaaS billing, experimentation, PLG and sales-led funnel infrastructure), Analytics (data visualization and architecture, ClickHouse, and LLM-powered analytics Q&A), and Member Growth (onboarding, activation, and removing the friction that keeps a business from growing).

We’re looking for a Lead Engineer to own **Analytics** and **Member Growth**. This is a hands-on role. You’ll write a lot of the code, make the hard technical calls, and lead a small team of tenured engineers. Most of your week goes to building and reviewing. The rest goes to running the team: 1:1s, planning, and helping people grow.

You’ll own two things. First, how digital business owners understand what’s happening in their business, including the analytics Circle AI uses to answer their questions. Second, how a new member goes from signing up to actually showing up. Millions of people join and use Circle every month, so small changes here have an outsized impact.

 
### What you'll be doing

- Leading, growing, and coaching a team of engineers across Analytics and Member Growth, while remaining hands-on — reviewing designs and PRs, and shipping code yourself daily.

- Owning the technical strategy and architecture for Circle's analytics stack: rich, interactive data visualizations, ClickHouse data infrastructure, and LLM-powered experiences that enable business owners to ask questions about their data in natural language.

- Owning the roadmap for Member Growth: onboarding flows, activation, and reducing the friction that stands between a new member and real engagement in a community.

- Partnering with product, design, data, and leadership to turn ambiguous problems into a cohesive, data-informed growth roadmap with measurable outcomes.

- Work AI-first. Use agents for planning, coding, review, and triage; stay critical of what they produce and help the team build shared tools that make all of us faster.

- Designing and overseeing A/B tests and experimentation to validate changes that improve activation, retention, and community health.

- Hiring, mentoring, and developing engineers, and running performance and career-growth processes for your team.

### What you'll need to be successful

- Prior experience leading or managing engineering teams. You’ve led engineers on large initiatives. You set direction, reviewed their work, and helped them get better while staying one of the strongest builders on the team.

- A product mindset: you understand our customers deeply enough to question and shape requirements, not just implement them. You're comfortable making fast, independent decisions following SaaS/product best practices.

- 7+ years of experience shipping production software on complex web applications, including experience with Ruby on Rails, MySQL/PostgreSQL, ReactJS, and TypeScript.

- Strong track record in at least one of: data/analytics infrastructure (e.g., ClickHouse, data warehousing, BI), or growth/lifecycle product engineering (onboarding, activation, retention); exposure to both is a strong plus.

results.text:
# Lead Engineer, Growth @ Alt Platform Inc

- Location: Remote
- Type: FullTime
- Workplace: Remote
- Team: Product and Data
- Department: Product and Data
- Compensation: $200K – $220K • Offers Equity

Alt is unlocking the value of alternative assets, starting with the $5 B trading-card market. We let collectors buy, sell, vault, and finance their cards in one place and we are backed by leaders at Stripe, Coinbase, Seven Seven Six, and pro athletes like Tom Brady and Giannis Antetokounmpo. Our next frontier is real-time pricing at scale—the Alt Value that powers every trade, loan, and product on the platform.

### The Role

You are our founding Growth Engineer, and you turn today's experiments into instrumented, repeatable systems across both sides of the marketplace — sellers and buyers. Attribution that we trust. A submission funnel we can measure step by step. Lifecycle messaging that is an owned system rather than a stack of per-campaign setups. Channels we can scale on purpose instead of by accident.

**The metric you own: unique submissions.** It is our north star, the whole company watches it, and you'll be held to it with the same weekly-reported discipline we hold marketing to.

It's a technical owner who understands growth levers and can build them — thinks like a PM, builds like an engineer. You'll partner directly with our founder and our Head of Marketing, own the funnel end to end, and the ceiling here is running the growth function. The people who are great at this have stepped back from a backlog before, instrumented a funnel nobody had instrumented, found the real blocker, and gone after it without being asked.

### What You'll Own

- **The activation funnel.** Rebuild the submission funnel end to end, instrument every step, and run a real experimentation loop on it — A/B testing, and re-engagement for the users who exit without submitting. Today a drop-off is an anecdote. It should be a number with a name on it.

- **Acquisition channels that actually acquire.** Work out which channels bring in real users on both sides — lifecycle, SEO, AEO, paid, mobile ads — and build the machinery to scale the ones that work. That includes agentic optimization: how Alt ranks and shows up in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other assistants. That surface is new for everyone. It's yours.

- **The data and attribution foundation.** This is the unlock for everything else. Stand up clean attribution, consolidate our product analytics into a single source of truth, and modernize the messaging and deep-linking stack so we can finally tell what moved the needle. Until this is right, every other result is contestable.

- **Lifecycle infrastructure.** Turn push, in-app, email, and SMS into an owned, instrumented system rather than per-campaign setups — including SMS opt-in compliance, which is not optional and not glamorous.

- **Marketplace balance.** Watch the balance across bidders, buyers, and sellers, and build growth into whichever side is weak. A marketplace that grows one side only doesn't grow.

### How You'll Use AI Here

We don't want to hear that you use Claude every day. Everyone does. We want to know what you've built with it. Concretely, in this role:

- Own **agentic search visibility as an engineering problem**: instrument how Alt gets represented in ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini answers, build the harness that measures it across a set of real collector queries, and treat the results as a channel with a dashboard rather than a guess

- Stand up an **agent that reads the funnel** — event stream, attribution tables, experiment results — and hands you the ranked list of steps where users are leaking, with a hypothesis attached to each

- Use models to **generate and QA lifecycle content at variant scale** — dozens of push, email, and SMS variants per test, screened for compliance and tone before a human reads them, so experiment velocity stops being bottlenecked on copy

- Put an **MCP server over product analytics and attribution** so "which channel produced last week's submissions" is a sentence, not another one-off query and a Slack thread

- Use **Claude Code or Cursor** as the default way you rebuild the funnel instrumentation or migrate the analytics stack, not as autocomplete

If you've built agents, wired up connectors, written skills or MCP servers, or shipped internal tooling your team actually depends on — lead with that. Name the artifact, not the tool.

### What You Bring

- **5+ years of engineering experience** with strong backend (Python, Postgres, AWS or similar) and frontend (React, React Native, JavaScript/TypeScript) chops. This seat is genuinely both.

- **A track record of owning growth systems or product features from design to production.** Design doc to shipped, not a ticket you closed.

- **Fluency with growth tooling and analytics** — experimentation and A/B frameworks, product analytics (PostHog, Amplitude, or similar), attribution (AppsFlyer or similar), and lifecycle platforms.

- **A sharp instinct for funnels and instrumentation**, and the patience to turn messy data into clean, trustworthy signal. Most of the first six months is this.

- **Comfort owning a north-star metric.** You've held a number publicly, weekly, and you know what it feels like when it doesn't move.

- **Strong collaboration and communication.** You write great docs, ask smart questions, and give thoughtful feedback.

**Bonus:** familiarity with the collectibles space or alternative asset marketplaces. You collect, or you have a view on where this market is going.

### How We'll Interview You

We'll be specific so you can prepare. *Before any of it: download the app, put a card up, make a bid, and try selling. Every round assumes you've used the product, and we expect your point of view to sharpen as you go.* For this role in particular, pay attention to where the submission flow made you hesitate — we will ask.

**1. Recruiter screen — 25 minutes, Google Meet.** Come ready to talk about the metric you own today and how you're performing against it, why Alt specifically, and how you're actually using AI. We'll align on comp and answer your questions

**2. Hiring manager Interview— 45 minutes, Google Meet.** Be ready to go deep on a growth system you owned end to end: what the funnel looked like, what you instrumented, what you changed, and what the number did. Bring the numbers.

**3. Technical screen — 60 minutes.**A hands-on working session (Live Coder pad) 

**4. Architecture and system design — 60 minutes.** 

**5. Culture interview — 30 minutes.** How you work with the people on the other side of the funnel: marketing, product, design.

**6. Leore, our founder and CEO — 30 minutes.** Everyone who joins Alt meets Leore. Come with a point of view on what you'd go after first on unique submissions.

**7. Reference check(s) — 15 minutes** with a former manager(s).

**Compensation:** $200,000 - $220,000 per year, plus equity for all full-time employees.

## What we offer:

***For full-time Employees***

- We cover 85% of your medical, dental, and vision, and up to 50% for dependents. HSA/FSA available 

- Generous PTO that people actually take

- Parental leave at full salary

- $200/month wellness + $100/month home office stipend

- Free DoorDash Pass membership, because dinner shouldn't be a decision

- Remote-first (for most positions), with WeWork access when you want a room with other humans

- 401(k)

- Alt Equity to all full-time employees

Apply here

🇩🇪 Wir haben eine klare Mission: Wir bauen Europas führende Plattform für Energiemanagement, um **faire und saubere Energie für alle** zugänglich zu machen. ⚡

**Your mission**

**Your tasks**

We’re Germany’s fastest-growing digital green energy provider and a Certified B Corp™ , driving the energy transition by making renewable energy more accessible and inclusive.
